question.text: If the maximum value of <math><mi>x</mi></math> which satisfies the inequality <math><mrow><mrow><msup><mrow><mi mathvariant="normal">sin</mi></mrow><mrow><mo>-</mo><mn>1</mn></mrow></msup></mrow><mo>⁡</mo><mrow><mfenced separators="|"><mrow><mrow><mrow><mi mathvariant="normal">sin</mi></mrow><mo>⁡</mo><mrow><mi>x</mi></mrow></mrow></mrow></mfenced></mrow></mrow><mo>≥</mo><mrow><mrow><msup><mrow><mi mathvariant="normal">cos</mi></mrow><mrow><mo>-</mo><mn>1</mn></mrow></msup></mrow><mo>⁡</mo><mrow><mfenced separators="|"><mrow><mrow><mrow><mi mathvariant="normal">sin</mi></mrow><mo>⁡</mo><mrow><mi>x</mi></mrow></mrow></mrow></mfenced></mrow></mrow></math> for <math><mi>x</mi><mo>∈</mo><mfenced separators="|"><mrow><mfrac><mrow><mi>π</mi></mrow><mrow><mn>2</mn></mrow></mfrac><mo>,</mo><mi></mi><mn>2</mn><mi>π</mi></mrow></mfenced></math> is <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mi>λ</mi></math>, then <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mfrac><mrow><mn>2</mn><mi>λ</mi></mrow><mn>3</mn></mfrac></math> is equal to (take <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mi>π</mi><mo>=</mo><mn>3</mn><mo>.14</mo></math>)

solution.text:
Let t=sin⁡x
From the graphs of sin-1⁡t and cos-1⁡t, we know that,

 sin-1⁡t≥cos-1⁡t for t∈12,1

  ⇒sin⁡x∈12,1
Hence, x∈π2,3π4
Maximum value is 3π4=λ

So, 2λ3=π2=1.57
